Who is responsible

Buddha Chat is operated by Ming Chieh Lin. For support and privacy requests, contact forestoceanlife@gmail.com.

This notice covers the Buddha Chat app and this support website. It does not describe other apps with similar names.

What we collect

An account identifier connects your saved conversations, reflections, privacy choices, optional memories, observations, and practice records. You can begin as a guest. If you choose Sign in with Apple, Apple and our authentication provider process identity information, which may include an email address and an Apple account identifier, to connect and recover your account.

The things you type may reveal sensitive information, including your beliefs, health, feelings, or relationships. Share only what you want processed. Avoid including another person’s private information.

We use this information to provide the features you request, preserve your history, personalize replies when you enable memory, keep the service working, and handle support or deletion requests. We do not use it to serve advertisements or sell it.

When AI receives your words

The app asks before enabling cloud AI processing. When you agree, your message and selected conversation context travel through our service to Anthropic to generate a reply. With memory enabled, selected content is also processed to identify useful details and tentative observations.

You can withdraw AI permission in You → Privacy. This stops new AI processing; it does not erase earlier requests. You can continue to view and delete saved information when the service is available.

Temporary does not mean offline. Temporary chat text is not stored in Buddha Chat’s conversation or memory database, but it still passes through our service and Anthropic. A temporary session is held in app memory while it is active. This service is not end-to-end encrypted.

Anthropic’s standard API policy says inputs and outputs are deleted within 30 days, with exceptions for safety enforcement, legal requirements, and certain services or agreements. Flagged content may be retained longer. We do not promise zero retention. See Anthropic’s retention policy for its current details.

Manage what is remembered

  • Memories: inspect, correct, or forget a detail in You → Memories.
  • Memory switch: turn long-term memory off in You → Privacy to stop learning and using details across conversations. Existing memories remain available for you to manage.
  • Individual conversations: exclude a conversation from personalization or delete it using its conversation options.
  • Temporary chat: use a conversation that is not added to saved history or long-term memory.

Forgetting a memory does not remove the words from an earlier saved conversation. Delete that conversation separately if you want to remove its transcript. Information you deliberately share again later may be treated as new information.

Retention and deletion

Saved account content remains until you delete it or request account deletion. Open You → Privacy → Delete all my data to request account deletion. Once the server accepts it, your account closes to new activity and cleanup is queued. Identity disconnection may need retries if Apple or our authentication service is unavailable.

We retain a minimal deletion record containing an opaque account identifier and deletion time, without conversation text, to prevent deleted accounts from being restored or reused. These records currently have no automatic expiry.

Deleting content from Buddha Chat does not immediately delete copies already processed by a provider. Provider security logs and any retained backup copies follow their separate retention arrangements. We do not promise instant removal from every system or a fixed backup-erasure deadline. The beta does not offer a guaranteed backup or restoration service.

Support messages and information you choose to send by email are handled in our support mailbox to respond to your request. Do not email passwords, sign-in codes, or a complete private conversation history.

Providers and security

Supabase hosts our account service, application database, and backend functions. Anthropic provides AI processing. Apple provides optional Apple sign-in and TestFlight distribution. Our application database is configured in the United States; service providers may process information in other countries under their own arrangements.

Network requests use encrypted transport. Account access controls separate saved information by account. No security measure can guarantee complete protection.

The app has no advertising or cross-app tracking SDK. Service diagnostics can include request information, response status, timing, and usage counts. Our application metrics omit conversation text. Hosting and authentication providers may separately record network and security information, such as IP addresses. Apple may share TestFlight diagnostics and feedback according to your TestFlight settings.

For more information, see Supabase’s privacy policy, Anthropic’s privacy policy, and Apple’s TestFlight privacy information.

This website

This website provides information and email links. It has no chat form, advertising, analytics code, or cookies set by our page code. These pages are hosted with OpenAI Sites and Cloudflare infrastructure. Hosting security may set necessary cookies and process connection and access information to deliver and protect the pages. We do not add advertising or analytics cookies. Opening an email link uses your email application; any email you send is handled by the relevant email providers.

Beta access and children

The current beta is intended for invited development testers. Public access, including an experience for children, has not launched. The beta has no child accounts or parental-consent flow.

App Store distribution in European Union countries is not planned for this release. Store availability does not determine or waive any privacy rights that apply to you.

If a child has provided personal information through the beta, contact us so we can help identify and remove it.

Contact and privacy requests

Contact forestoceanlife@gmail.com to ask about access, correction, deletion, or another privacy request. Tell us what you need without sending private conversation text. We may ask for enough information to verify your account before disclosing or changing account information. Never send us your password or Apple verification code.

Your rights depend on the law that applies to you. Nothing in this notice limits rights provided by law. We will update this page when our handling of information changes, and the app will request new permission when its AI-consent requirements change.
